Done. This question was a clean success that confirmed the existing CAGR period-count rule rather than exposing anything genuinely new.

What I did: tightened the existing CAGR memory note to (a) remove a dangling reference to a "cagr-period-count" file that doesn't actually exist, and (b) explicitly document the forward-projection variant that this question used — since the prior note only had the historical-CAGR example.

The generalizable pattern, now recorded:
- Period count n = END_year − START_year (March 2001 → March 2006 = 5, not 6)
- Forward projection: r = (V_end / V_start)^(1/n) − 1, then V_target = V_end × (1+r)^m, where m = target − end years (here March 2006 → March 2011 = 5)

No new skill needed — the existing officeqa-treasury-bulletin skill plus this memory note cover the pattern fully.
